entry.title: NASA, Energy Department Advance New Era of Nuclear-Powered Exploration
entry.summary: As the Golden Age of deep-space exploration begins, NASA and the U.S. Department of Energy are advancing the development of safe, reliable, next-generation nuclear technologies for space. “Thanks to President Trump, America’s nuclear renaissance is reaching a new frontier,” said Wright. “The Energy Department is proud to partner with NASA as we help American space missions reach uncharted territory.” 关键事实：As the Golden Age of deep-space exploration begins；Department of Energy are advancing the development of safe；next-generation nuclear technologies for space

entry.title: Raytheon awarded $6.3 billion multi-year contract for SM-3 IB interceptors
entry.summary: Raytheon has secured a five-year contract, with two additional option years, valued up to $6.3 billion for the production and sustainment of Standard Missile-3 Block IB (SM‑3 IB) interceptors. “SM-3 Block IB has proven its relevance in combat and this contract helps ensure we can replenish inventories and keep pace with the evolving threats the U.S. Navy, MDA and their partners face around the world.” RTX has made significant investments to expand capacity and accelerate production of critical munitions including the Standard Missile Family. 关键事实：Raytheon has secured a five-year contract；with two additional option years；valued up to $6.3 billion for the production

entry.title: Pentagon barred Qatar base access to hide Iran war damage, US senator claims
entry.summary: A U.S. senator was recently denied access to the largest military installation in the Middle East, calling it a “cover-up” over the damage suffered during the Iran war. Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., visited the Middle East this week on a Congressional Delegation trip, speaking with Gulf region leaders and visiting American facilities to assess damage done by the Iran war. Murphy was denied access to Al Udeid Air Base, Qatar, which had suffered damage from drone strikes during the conflict. 关键事实：senator was recently denied access to the largest military installation in the Middle East；calling it a “cover-up” over the damage suffered during the Iran war；Chris Murphy

entry.title: Shield AI and U.S. government investment in X-BAT reaches $400 million
entry.summary: Shield AI announced that the U.S. Navy has executed a $150 million modification to its existing Other Transaction (OT) agreement with the company to advance X-BAT, an AI-piloted, vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL) fighter aircraft. The Navy executed the $150 million modification with funding from the Office of the Under Secretary of War for Acquisition and Sustainment through its Defense Exportability Features program. Shield AI will invest $150 million of its own capital in X-BAT alongside the government funding. 关键事实：Shield AI announced that the U.S；Navy has executed a $150 million modification to its existing Other Transaction (OT) agreement with the company to advance X-BAT；an AI-piloted

entry.title: France to start training Ukrainian pilots on Rafale warplanes in November, minister says
entry.summary: PARIS — France will begin training Ukrainian pilots on the Rafale fighter jet next month, Armed Forces Minister Catherine Vautrin said in a parliamentary hearing on Thursday. “From November, we will begin the first training of Ukrainian pilots on Rafale.” Ukrainian pilots will soon begin training on Rafale aircraft in France, a major step forward for Ukraine’s combat aviation, the country’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a Telegram post on Monday, citing a conversation with his French counterpart Emmanuel Macron. 关键事实：PARIS — France will begin training Ukrainian pilots on the Rafale fighter jet next month

entry.title: Helm.ai reaches $70M in signed commercial contracts for its foundation models
entry.summary: Helm.ai said it has commercial partners spanning perception, full-stack autonomous driving, automated data labeling, and generative simulation. | Source: Helm.ai Helm.ai today said it has signed $70 million in commercial contracts for its foundation models for physical AI over a 12-month period. Inside Helm.ai’s ‘deep teaching’ methodology Helm.ai trained its foundation models using its unsupervised “deep teaching” methodology to master the structure of the physical world itself.

entry.title: Energy Department Announces New Genesis Mission Awards to Accelerate Scientific Capability
entry.summary: Insider Brief The Department of Energy announced $159 million for 12 new Phase II Genesis Mission projects using AI and advanced computing to accelerate scientific research. The projects include Harvard -led quantum computing error correction, Oak Ridge-led quantum magnet design, and efforts in fusion energy, biotechnology, geothermal energy and particle physics. The Department of Energy announced $159 million for 12 new Phase II Genesis Mission projects using AI and advanced computing to accelerate scientific research. 关键事实：The Department of Energy announced $159 million for 12 new Phase II Genesis Mission projects using AI；advanced computing to accelerate scientific research；The projects include Harvard-led quantum computing error correction

entry.title: A single prompt was enough to hijack every AI agent in an AWS account, Zenity researchers found
entry.summary: A chain of vulnerabilities in Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore platform let researchers take over all of a company's AI agents in the same AWS region through a single chat message to one public agent. Researchers at Zenity Labs say a single publicly accessible AI agent on Amazon's Bedrock AgentCore was enough to take over every AgentCore agent in the same AWS account and region. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is AWS' platform for running enterprise AI agents with tools, memory, and access management. 关键事实：Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is AWS' platform for running enterprise AI agents with tools
